about: Library health cases, shared by Octo's server (octo.Tests/LibraryHealthCasesTests.cs) and the Octo app (shared/core health tests). Songs and albums are written as Subsonic answers them, so each side reads them with its own song type. 'facts' gives each album id a release, release group, barcode or record label; 'places' puts songs in another place; 'seen' limits the tags the reader keeps. An expectation left out is not checked. Duplicates and split albums are listed in the order the report gives them.
